name: Background Frequency Map
description: Maps 周波数 content of background regions
algorithm: Background Frequency Map — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method creates frequency maps of video backgrounds for forensic deepfake detection:

1. **BackgroundSegmentation**: Face/body regions are segmented and separated from the background using semantic segmentation. The background region is isolated for independent frequency analysis, avoiding frequency interference from the dynamically changing foreground.

2. **空間的周波数マッピング**: 2D FFT is computed over background regions in each frame, creating a spatial frequency map. Natural backgrounds exhibit stable frequency content dominated by scene-specific features (texture of walls, furniture patterns, foliage). The frequency map reveals the spectral signature of the background.

3. **時間的周波数安定性**: Background frequency maps across frames are compared. In authentic video with a stationary camera, background frequencies remain nearly constant. Deepfake generators may introduce frame-to-frame frequency artifacts in the background — subtle spectral flickering from imperfect temporal consistency in the generation process.

4. **Cross-領域周波数一貫性**: Different background regions should show frequency characteristics consistent with a single imaging pipeline. GAN or diffusion-generated backgrounds may show frequency inconsistencies between spatial regions — different noise patterns, compression artifacts, or spectral energy distributions in different parts of the generated background.

5. **周波数異常スコアリング**: The temporal variance of background frequency maps, cross-region frequency consistency, and deviation from expected spectral profiles are combined into a forensic score. Elevated scores indicate backgrounds that exhibit frequency characteristics inconsistent with natural video capture.
parameters:
分析タイプ: 周波数
メディア: 動画
入力: Video frames extracted at key intervals
出力: 信頼度スコア (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中〜高 — 70-88% 単独精度. Most effective when combined with other 動画 forensic methods. Performance depends on 動画 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 動画 through background 周波数 map analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 動画 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 動画 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 動画 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 動画 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 動画
